g.text: I'd love to take your Atomicycle for a ride.
Hey mind if I borrow your Atomicycle? ;)
If you touch it I'll murder you in your Sol-loving sleep.
C'mon. What's the worst that could happen?
Okay, you drive. I'll sit on the back. Joyride.
And no one will find the corpse.
Chill! I was just playing around!
Because that thing is my pride and joy. And you'll take it and ruin it.
Why would you assume I'd take something of yours and - oh...
Fine. I'll go get my own. And it'll be cooler anyway. [End.]
How was I supposed to know?!
I'll just... use my own instead...
That's what the winky face was for!
You might be a lot of things, Drifter. But at least you're not stupid.
Tilt your head to the left and look for the face. That's called an "emoticon."
You're starting to make a lot more sense, now...
I came off harsh. Tell you what. When you get your own? We'll go riding together.
They sound a lot better than those messed-up horses you mentioned.
Well...shit. I think I need to apologize to Aoi for...a lot. Be right back.
